title: StarkweatherOFC-CCEP: orbitofrontal cortico-cortical evoked potential recordings, 7 patients (Starkweather et al.) (derivative)
description: Intracranial recordings of cortico-cortical evoked potentials (CCEPs) elicited by single-pulse electrical stimulation of orbitofrontal cortex in seven patients. The derivative release contains the authors' preprocessed per-electrode timeseries, both unreferenced and bipolar-referenced, at 1000 Hz, together with stimulation event timing and amplitudes. It supports analysis of effective connectivity and rapid homotopic communication between human orbitofrontal subregions.
methods_description: Authors' preprocessed per-electrode orbitofrontal timeseries (unreferenced and adjacent-contact bipolar) were repackaged as BrainVision float32 in microvolts. Single-pulse stimulation times and amplitudes were written to events.tsv, and electrode sulcus-relative distances to electrodes.tsv. No further processing was applied.
